description: Look up one entity in the federal UID register (BFS) by its UID, e.g. 'CHE-107.028.276', 'CHE107028276', '107028276' or a VAT number 'CHE-107.028.276 MWST'. Validates the check digit first (offline). Returns name, legal form, address, UID status, VAT register status (registered yes/no, VAT number, entry date) and commercial-register status. Covers ALL UID holders incl. associations, foundations, sole proprietors and public bodies that are not in ZEFIX.

uid.description: UID in any format, e.g. 'CHE-107.028.276' or '107028276'

name: lookup_uid
title: Look up a Swiss UID
